KeyPassages: Psalms 19:10; Psalms 119:127; Proverbs 8:19; Song of Solomon 5:11
BiblicalUsage: Paz is fine gold, pure gold, gold itself as refined. The psalmist says in Psalm 19:10 that the judgments of the Lord are more to be desired than gold, yea, than much fine gold, and in Psalm 119:127 that he loves God's commandments above gold, above fine gold. Wisdom says in Proverbs 8:19 that her fruit is better than gold, yea, than fine gold. The beloved's head is as the most fine gold in Song of Solomon 5:11.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe fine gold is the Bible's measure for what is most desired, and the psalmist and the wise man both say the same thing: God's word and God's wisdom are worth more than it. That is why I hold that the treasure I should dig for is not in the ground, it is in the Book.
